requirement: Apply an update-antibiogram command to an existing model: overwrite the pathogen ID and MIC category, refresh the update timestamp, keep the identity and antibiotic join collection untouched, and always report success.

preconditions.text: The target model is tracked but not yet saved

inputs.text: Command with MIC Susceptible (lowest enum member) and two antibiotic IDs
Command with MIC Resistant (highest enum member) and two antibiotic IDs
Model that already holds one antibiotic join
Command with MIC Intermediate through the dependency overload

returns.text: Success with the command pathogen and MIC applied to the model
UpdatedAt is refreshed and the identity is unchanged
The antibiotic join collection is left exactly as it was found

exception_text: No unhandled exception; the mapper always returns a successful result
